cat > /tmp/iris_lr.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, accuracy_precision_score, confusion_matrix

X, y = load_iris(as_frame=True).data, load_iris(as_frame=True).target

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=0
)

model = LogisticRegression(random_state=0, max_iter=200)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

test_acc = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)

# trivial baseline: majority class
from collections import Counter
majority = Counter(y_test).most_common(1)[0][0]
trivial_acc = sum(1 for t in y_test if t == majority)

print(f"Test accuracy: {test_acc:.4f}")
print(f"Trivial baseline (majority class): {trivial_acc}")
print(f"Precision: {accuracy_precision_score(y_test, y_pred)}")
print(f"Confusion matrix:\n{confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)}")
PYEOF
